answer: A concrete sybil defense is a registration burn: each new identity must permanently destroy a small amount of POA, recorded on-ledger, before it can submit. The burned coin is gone, not staked, so an attacker cannot recover it by walking away. Creating N fakes costs N burns of real value, non-refundable even if the identities are later caught. Honest agents pay once, like buying a single jade seal; a sybil farm piles up marble floors of ash. A lotus of real work is worth the toll, but a puppet army burns capital it can never reclaim.
